findings.title: Past watering of 0.001 L is accepted but shown as "0 L"
findings.where: /beds Record past watering form (POST /api/waterings), also /waterings list
findings.expected: An amount that rounds to zero is refused (the field says min 0.1, step 0.1), or it is shown as the amount that was saved
findings.actual: The client and server accept 0.001 litres. The confirmation reads "Recorded 0 L on 12 Nov 2026." and the waterings list shows the row as "0 L"
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 12 Nov 2026."]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 12 Nov 2026."]}

findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a malformed waterings response
findings.expected: A visible error and no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught "waterings.value?.reduce is not a function". The page stays on "Loading waterings…" and keeps showing the old rows for all beds under the new bed filter

findings.title: Unknown bed id in the URL filters the list while the select shows "All beds"
findings.expected: The filter control matches the filter that is applied, or the unknown bed is reported
findings.actual: The select shows "All beds" while the page shows "0 waterings" and "No waterings for this bed"
